Use complete native Swiss Sand atmine as a screening proxy for five ordinary pit/quarry/river producer entries, retaining each original signed kg quantity, producer share and uncertainty. Native joint Swiss sand/gravel extraction differs from source hydraulic openpit, river dredging/slurry/washing, grading, moisture including BR5% water, allocation, geography, technologies, internal uncertainty and vintage. Do not introduce moisture, density, yield or price-update factors, recycled-resource-correction or regional-storage wrappers. The RoW source zinc-mine sand coproduct has264 nonproduction coordinates proportional to source zinc concentrate by1/95, including supported uncertainty; frozen prices .004/.38 confirm the ratio. Concentrate is59%Zn; native Swedish beneficiation references1kgcontainedZn. Retain its original9.19504300903769e-5kg share with an allocated burden helper consuming .59/95kg native contained-Zn beneficiation perkg source coproduct. This is an allocated-mining screening proxy, not physical zinc added to sand or avoided metal: no ordinary quarry input or recovery/refining credit. Warn ore, coproducts, economic allocation, tailings, resources, emissions, geography and internal uncertainty differences. Preserve all17 original freight entries separately at their original nettkm, quantities and supported uncertainty. Complete native same-mode rail, barge, sea and fleet services include their infrastructure once. Source BR EURO3 classes use inspected CH fleet classes; >32t becomes32-40t, with explicit fleet, emissions standard, geography and upper-class approximation warnings. RoW/IN generic and lightroad use complete matching service classes, not coal-only traction or vehicle operation only. No payload, distance or mass multiplier, normalization or omission. Retain complete native inventories and native internal uncertainty; source producer internal formulas and uncertainty are not reproduced. LCIA differences remain unquantified, including upstream biosphere exclusions. Preserve caller signed quantities, formula, uncertainty, ownership and separate emissions. Only three exact3.9cutoff sand markets are approved, not standalone production, other versions, reverse or cross-system-model conversion.

All264 source nonproduction exchanges and supported uncertainty equal1/95 of source zinc-concentrate inventory, matching frozen prices .004/.38.
